critique: The strongest move is the invented inversion rule: wherever the stepped emerald wedge swings into the vermilion slab, it flips to flat cobalt with a chartreuse core and paper-colored teeth, and the dwell-glide sweep makes that seam travel across the slab's notches. That is a genuinely unfamiliar grammar, delivered in razor-flat, high-contrast cut-paper on a pale linen ground, exactly as the high-key brief asks. The weakness is the attached guinea pig: a soft-lined, tri-colored cartoon with an orange-and-brown face patch, it is the one surprising element on the page, yet it is shrunk to a 17px, 56%-opacity smudge near the bottom edge. It should either be committed at scale as a deliberate collision with the hard geometry or cut, along with some of the accessories crowding a "spare" brief: the datum comb, plumb counterweight, rotating collar and witness shard.
